profile.headline: Lecturer at California State University, Long Beach
profile.summary:
Adjunct professor with over six years of teaching experience at California State University Long Beach and software developer with about one year of experience developing and maintaining software at National Sign Inc. Ability to teach, learn and apply multiple high level programming languages (e.g. Java, C++, Python) to meet clients’ needs.

I was afraid of programming at first although I can understand the logic of how to solve a problem. I overcame my fear of programming when I was in graduate study. I wrote a program in Matlab to detect an unknown surface by designing a system of mirrors to reflect light wave on the surface. That moment was definitely a game changer. After graduate, I started teaching introductory courses in Java and Python, which were the two languages I taught myself. I enjoy programming so much that I went on to obtain a degree in computer science. My dream is to build an AI that can recognize medicinal plants and herbs. 

I can quickly learn new skills and programming languages. I was contracted to build a desktop app to monitor/adjust solar light tower using C# and XAML. The most challenging part about this project for me is two bind two different UI to control a single brightness plot of the device. I had to apply the Model View View Model to organize my code. In addition, my latest project requires me to learn Laravel Framework, Tailwind CSS and Vue.js to create a website, which manages accounts and devices. These accomplishment will boost my confidence for future projects.

CAREER HIGHLIGHTS
•	Taught a variety of lower-division computer science courses using C++, Java, Python and core concepts (e.g. object oriented, data structures, algorithms) to lay a foundation for undergraduate students.
•	Demonstrated an application of AI by modifying the VGG16 Convolution Neural Network to predict (up to 60% accuracy) facial expressions (e.g. sad, happy, surprise, etc.) of a given picture.
•	Wrote bash scripts to grade students’ assignments automatically.
•	Built a Light Tower desktop application by converting WinForms to WPF and using C# and XAML.

positions.description: Maintain and improve legacy code; design, develop, and test software according to the requirements of customers.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description:
• CIS 185 – Discrete Structures
o Sets, functions, logic, relations, graphs, trees, recursion, combinatorics, and mathematical reasoning.

• CIS 280X – Object Oriented Programming C++
o Pointers, references, memory management, stream I/O, classes, operator overloading, exception
handling, STL, data abstraction, object-oriented design, data structures (linked lists, stacks, queues and
trees)

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
• CECS 100 – Critical Thinking in the Digital Information Age (Python)
Identifying engineering issues for investigation, developing planning and problem solving strategies, locating pertinent information and examples, critically analyzing these sources, forming and testing hypotheses, and developing transferable problem solving skills.
• CECS 174 – Introduction to Programming and Problem Solving (Python)
Variables, data types, conditional statements, loops and arrays, programming style, and applications to numerical and non-numerical problems.
• CECS 228 – Discrete Structures with Computing Applications
Sets, functions, logic, relations, graphs, trees, recursion, combinatorics, and mathematical reasoning.
• CECS 229 – Discrete Structures with Computing Applications II (Python)
Applications of computer arithmetic and matrices in computer systems.
• CECS 271 – Introduction to Numerical Methods (Matlab)
Numerical methods for algebraic equations, computer arithmetic, error propagation, fixed and arbitrary precision, numerical integration and differentiation, ordinary differential equations, Fourier Transform, discrete Fourier Transform.
• CECS 274 – Object Oriented Programming and Data Structures (Java)
Data abstraction, object-oriented design, data structures (linked lists, stacks, queues and trees), recursion, sorting, and searching.
• CECS 282 – C++ for Java Programmers (C++)
Pointers, references, memory management, stream I/O, classes, operator overloading, exception handling, STL.
• CECS 328 – Data Structures and Algorithms
Divide and conquer, dynamic programming and greedy algorithms; basic search and traversal techniques including search trees; sorting; matrix manipulations; NP–completeness.

positions.title: Avid Tutor

• Served as positive role model for high school students at all grade level. 
• Conducted tutorial sessions (group of 5-7) in all areas of Mathematics.

projects.title: Cloud Web Application for Device Finder System
projects.description:
•	Design website using Laravel Framework, Tailwind CSS and VueJs.
•      Website will provide information about company's devices via cellular connection. 
•	Information of devices can be updated through an account from the website. 
•	Design database for data management using MySQL

projects.title: Light Tower Desktop Application
projects.description:
•	Designed and tested software which controls (e.g. turn on/off, adjust brightness, etc.) a solar light tower using C# .NET and XAML.
•	Added a graphical visualization to show the status of the solar light tower using Oxyplot.
•	Convert legacy code from Winforms into Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) to create better UI experience
